BREAKING NEWS:
MAJOR TRAFFIC ADVISORY & GLITTER SHORTAGE ALERT

AT LOCATION:
Little Bay Islands (The "Metropolis" of the North)
DATE: December 20, 2025

SUBJECT: The Annual Santa Claus Parade

Citizens, rabbits, and seagulls of Little Bay Islands are hereby notified that the Annual Santa Claus Parade is scheduled for tomorrow (Sunday) at 1:00 PM sharp.
Please be advised that traffic delays are expected to last approximately 45 seconds. Crowd control barriers have been erected (it is a piece of rope tied between two trees).

The Stakes Have Never Been Higher!

While the parade officially features 100% of the island's human population, sources confirm that the holiday spirit has been replaced by ruthless competitive ambition.

For years, Mike and Georgina have walked these roads as the undisputed King and Queen of Resettlement Chic, basking in the glory of being the "Originals." But the winds of change are blowing, and they smell like fresh pine and vengeance.

Melv and Vera, the new full-time heavyweights, have entered the arena. Tired of living in the shadow of the existing regime, they have reportedly spent weeks in a secret underground bunker (Melv’s shed) constructing a float designed to shatter egos and secure bragging rights for the entire 2026 calendar year.

The Lineup

While details are heavily guarded under threat of snowball fights, leaked intelligence suggests the following:

Team "New Blood" (Melv & Vera): Rumor has it Melv has rigged an ATV with enough Christmas lights to be visible from the International Space Station. Their goal? To blind the competition—literally. Vera has been seen hoarding tinsel since October. They are coming for the crown.

Team "The Dynasty" (Mike & Georgina): Not to be outdone, the reigning champions are banking on "legacy points." Mike was overheard saying that their float captures the "true essence" of the island (which might just mean it’s an old skidoo on a sled, but with style). Georgina has been practicing her "Queen Elizabeth wave" for three days straight.

The Wildcard

Local media analysts warn that the entire event may be upstaged by Pepper.

The canine resident has been working on a "Top Secret" costume that insiders claim will redefine Christmas fashion. Is she a reindeer? Is she a lobster? No one knows, but she is currently polling at 98% approval, making her the frontrunner for "Best in Show."
Spectator Information

Where to Watch: Anywhere. Literally, if you stand outside, you will see it.

Parking: Wherever you want.

Safety Warning: Please do not feed the participants, especially if they look tired from dragging a generator behind a sled.

The parade begins at 1:00 PM. May the best float win, and may the loser handle the defeat with dignity (though we doubt it).
